strings: Weakened by the One Ring's power, at last Frodo claims it for himself...�
and the very foundations of Middle-earth are shaken.�
The Dark Lord desperately hopes for his very body to be restored to him.�
But to stride forth upon Middle-earth once more...�
Sauron requires Frodo's Ring, and for this he will gladly pay any price.�
At the Dark Lord's command, his Nazgûl now hasten to Mount Doom...�
all other thoughts banished from their minds.�
They obey but a single, deadly aim...�
to slay Frodo and gain the Ring, now that it lies within Sauron's grasp.�
Many Orc garrisons boldly dare to covet the Ring for themselves.�
Rising up in riot and civil war and marching upon Mount Doom.�
But the onrushing Nazgûl shall tolerate no delay...�
and will slay any dark servant who dares block their path.�
